_comment: Declared exceptions to the trade-ledger completeness check (executor/ledger_completeness.py). Each entry excuses ONE known divergence between the trades ledger and the EOD positions_snapshot, and only that divergence: it is matched on ticker AND the exact signed share delta (ledger net minus snapshot shares). A different delta on the same ticker is a new gap and fails. An entry needs a ruling id; the rows themselves are never edited. Ruling: nousergon/alpha-engine-config#12411, Brian 2026-10-21 16:34Z, 'Declare all' (the first seven), and Brian 2026-10-22 15:37Z, 'Declare all' (AKAM, CIEN, COST, PLTR, TER, VRTX). CRUS +136 is NOT declared: it is restated by its own script.
